copy.tagline: 自动调用 Apiflash 生成网页截图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要程序化获取网页快照
copy.tagline_en: Automate webpage screenshot generation using Apiflash API
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically capture webpage snapshots

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 Rube MCP 自动执行 Apiflash 操作（如网页截图）。使用前会先搜索最新工具列表，再检查连接状态，最后运行具体工具。
howto.when: 当你说出与 Apiflash 相关的需求（如“截图”、“网页快照”），且 Rube MCP 和 Apiflash 连接均激活时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Apiflash 截图 https://example.com
say.note: Claude会自动搜索工具并执行截图。

say.text: 检查我的 Apiflash 连接状态
用 Apiflash 批量截取这几个网页
say.note: Claude会按工作流执行多步操作。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can automate Apiflash tasks (e.g., webpage screenshots) via Rube MCP. It first searches for current tool schemas, checks connection status, then executes the specific tool.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Apiflash-related tasks (like 'screenshot' or 'snapshot'), provided Rube MCP and Apiflash connection are active.

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of https://example.com using Apiflash
say_en.note: Claude will search tools and execute the screenshot.

say_en.text: Batch screenshot these URLs with Apiflash
say_en.note: Claude follows the workflow for multiple operations.
